description_en: Associates projects with the scope of an audit policy. This operation can be invoked only when the ScopeType parameter returned by the GetReviewRule operation is 2
description_zh: 关联审计规则范围项目。仅当通过GetReviewRule接口获取到的对应审计规则中ScopeType参数返回值为2时可调用本接口
name: AttachProjectsToReviewRule

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the audit policy.
You can invoke the ListReviewRules operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
审计规则ID。
您可以调用ListReviewRules接口获取该参数
parameters.name: review_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The array of project IDs to associate.
You can call the ListProjects operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需要关联的项目ID数组。
您可以调用ListProjects接口获取该参数
parameters.name: project_ids

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
